headline: Homes from ₹56.7 lakh near Electronic City.
pitch: Shriram 107 South East is at Attibele, off Hosur Road. It is a large community at a price that lets a first-time buyer own a home near one of the city's biggest job hubs.

reasons.title: Electronic City now has a metro
reasons.text: The Yellow Line (RV Road to Bommasandra, 19.15 km, 16 stations) opened on 11 August 2025 and runs beside Hosur Road.
reasons.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

reasons.title: An entry price few areas still offer
reasons.text: Attibele asking prices average about ₹6,850 per sq.ft., well below most of Bengaluru.

reasons.title: Close to a major job hub
reasons.text: Electronic City and the Bommasandra and Attibele industrial areas are a short drive up Hosur Road.

reasons.title: A new ring road is planned
reasons.text: The Bengaluru Business Corridor (Peripheral Ring Road) is a 73 km road with a reported 2029 deadline, linking the Devanahalli side with the Sarjapur side.

upcoming.what: Yellow Line metro (RV Road to Bommasandra)
upcoming.status: Open since 11 August 2025. 19.15 km, 16 stations, running beside Hosur Road through Electronic City.
upcoming.why: Electronic City now has a working metro to the city, which supports both rents and resale.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.status: 73 km ring road with a reported 2029 deadline.
upcoming.why: Takes through-traffic off the Outer Ring Road and shortens cross-city trips.

upcoming.what: Blue Line metro at Silk Board
upcoming.status: The Blue Line starts at Central Silk Board, where it meets the Yellow Line. Trial runs on the Silk Board to KR Pura stretch were expected from late 2026.
upcoming.why: One change of train links the Hosur Road side to the Outer Ring Road offices and, later, the airport.

timelineSource: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026; Square Yards, 2026; Oneindia, 2026; Sattva Group market note, 2026. Government target dates can move.
band: The Yellow Line is open. Buyers here are paying an entry price for an area that already has its metro a short drive away.

area.name: Attibele
area.source: Square Yards property rates page, read 26 Nov 2026. Asking prices from listings, not registered sale prices.

up: More offices and factories around Electronic City
The metro being extended further down Hosur Road, if approved
Buyers priced out of the city looking south
down: The metro ending at Bommasandra, short of Attibele
Plenty of land, so supply can rise quickly
